preprocessing.control: saved old TF-IDF calibrated SVM + matched PRICE fallback
preprocessing.cleaning: exact historical body cleaning and alphabetic word extraction; same title and article membership
preprocessing.FREQUENCY: keep repeated occurrences rather than sorted unique tokens only
preprocessing.NUMERIC: add unique namespaced numeric expressions; historical alphabetic extraction unchanged
preprocessing.selection: text-only inner mean BA descending, Brier ascending, smaller C, matching historical SVM
preprocessing.calibration: same 3 shuffled stratified folds, independently refit TFIDF and classifier per calibration fold
preprocessing.vocabulary: min_df3 max5000 sublinearTF L2; unigram only
preprocessing.fallback: same saved PRICE on every no-news window

grouped.method: same fixed CONTROL SVM, original association-group outer and inner partitions
grouped.calibration: three StratifiedGroupKFold splits within each current fit; same group cannot cross calibration boundary
grouped.interpretation: association components not certified event IDs; separate robustness test, not a replacement main score

aggregation.base: TFIDF original stem_body max5000 plus train-standardized OLD16 divided by sqrt(16); L2 logistic regression
aggregation.geometry: standardize unique training chunks only; sigma median positive pair distance of seed573 permutation of up to1024 unique train chunks
aggregation.chunk_weights: existing token-count weights within each article; equal evidence articles within window
aggregation.normalization: L2 window semantic vector; same for all representations; zero if no evidence
aggregation.fit_scope: vocabulary, scaler, distance bandwidth fit separately within each training partition
aggregation.selection: fallback-applied inner mean BA descending, Brier ascending, smaller C
aggregation.fallback: exact saved PRICE when no news; news without evidence retains trained joint classifier with zero semantic block
aggregation.comparison: same LR and same word/price block; compare to FULL and fixed old calibrated SVM as external controls

followup.interactions: deferred unless MAP_THEN_MEAN improves both-stock three-seed mean BA vs SET_BASE and MEAN_THEN_MAP, improves at least2seeds perstock, Brier harm <=.002 each stock; descriptive budget screen not independent significance
followup.TabPFN: later conditional proposal only; not auto-run

reporting.paired_intervals: 1000 common-day and 5-day-block paired bootstrap; shared weights across seeds; descriptive
reporting.cases: seed573 hash-first2 per stock/method corrected, harmed, shared wrong, shared right; no causal claim
reporting.verification: all saved model containers reloaded without fit; inner selection recomputed; calibration membership and fallbacks; raw reconstruction; preservation
